about: Aurora Combat Tracker mechanics overlay. Names, book codes and measurements only; no rules text. Used only for spells the player has imported.

summons.name: Eldritch Cannon
summons.command: Bonus action while within 60 ft: activate one option and move it up to 15 ft.

variants.name: Flamethrower
variants.summary: 15-ft cone from the cannon · Dexterity save against your spell save DC · 2d8 fire, half on a success

variants.name: Force Ballista
variants.summary: Ranged spell attack, 120 ft · 2d8 force · a creature hit is pushed 5 ft away

variants.name: Protector
variants.summary: The cannon and creatures you choose within 10 ft gain 1d8 + your Intelligence modifier temporary HP (minimum 1)
